note: Act folders before the first layout move (2026-11-03) were named by act id; the 2026-11-15 move put the laws followed through their amendments under nomos/<year>/<number>/; the 2026-11-16 move gave the top-level folders English names (nomos/ -> laws/, diatagma/ -> decrees/, syntagma/ -> constitution/, ν. 4619/2019 and ν. 4620/2019 -> codes/). "previous" lists the folders an act had between the moves; tools/on.py reads all of them.
